n: LLMs Unplugged How AI writes stories lesson
t: A 60 or 90 minute lesson where students build a paper model that writes stories.
steps: Find the How AI writes stories lesson on the LLMs Unplugged site.
Download the slides, the printouts, and the lesson plan.
Print the sheets or cutouts from the site.
Gather pens, paper, and dice. Use a d10 for the grid activities.
Pick a new short text for training if you use the 90 minute version.
Read the presenter notes before class.
